sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout table covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; Do AI Agents Know, Who Grades the Grader, OAT, and PVDetector were already live, so the same table pivot selected arXiv:2607.12406.
Read the arXiv HTML and PDF text, extracted the five-boundary taxonomy, cross-boundary propagation argument, and isolation-by-construction agenda.
Translated the survey taxonomy into boundary tables, a risk formula, tool-boundary pseudocode, and Mermaid propagation graph.
Kept the article clear that this is a survey without new benchmark results, a formal model, or a deployable runtime.
Searched direct third-party commentary and related arXiv listings; substantive external analysis was sparse, so the article relies mainly on original paper evidence.
Wrote pure Markdown with TL;DR, tables, formula-style explanation, pseudocode, Mermaid, figure/table evidence notes, and limitations.
